nodes.label: v3/README.md — the HERB evaluation harness: run chosen HERB questions through three arms, get an answer from each, and score those answers two ways (HERB anchor + RAGAS lens).

Three arms (artifact / lucene / vector) all answer with the same generator built once and injected, so any difference is retrieval not the LLM; beyond that generator and the corpus on disk the arms share nothing.
Two scorers on purpose: HERB (eval/herb.py) is the exact leaderboard-comparable anchor, RAGAS (eval/ragas.py) is the multidimensional lens that transfers to a no-gold set later.
The RAGAS deterministic backbone is ID-based context precision/recall (IDBasedContextPrecision / IDBasedContextRecall) against the gold citations — judge-free, always runs because it costs nothing.

Data split / quarantine: data/corpus/ has the oracle stripped (pipelines see only this, via a truth-free prompt), data/raw/ holds full HERB truth read in place by evaluators, metadata directories stay on both sides as legitimate retrieval data.

Run flow is two separate phases — questions (one arm answers, writing an oracle-free records.jsonl) and evals (one scorer re-joins truth by id and scores) — plus full (both back to back), so iterating a scorer never re-runs the LLM.

The gold-100 is a balanced answerable subset drawn by seeded round-robin over the HERB types (equal allocation ~20/type); report per-type and don't compare its aggregate to HERB's natural-mix published average.

One LLM serves as generator AND judge: mistralai/mistral-large-3-675b-instruct-2512 on NVIDIA NIM — injected into all three arms and used as the RAGAS/HERB judge; multilingual, so HERB's GPT-4o baselines get re-run not cited.
The lucene arm is built: bm25s method='lucene' (k1=0.9 / b=0.4 BEIR values), one document per artifact, artifacts-only index — justified because all 17,087 gold citations resolve to an artifact id.

The vector arm is built: embedder nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 on NIM, one whole artifact per document embedded without chunking (8192-token context), exact brute-force cosine — a deliberate capable multilingual dense baseline, not all-MiniLM.

Question ids are minted deterministically (HERB ships none): <product>::a|u::<index> from product file/array/position — 815 answerable + 699 unanswerable = 1514 unique, the paired-test join key; the id filter is exact and raises on a miss.

Construct-validity caveat: answer-level scoring measures the whole pipeline so a strong generator can mask retrieval; the deterministic context precision/recall (and HERB's oracle setting) keeps an endpoint pointed at retrieval, the artefact's actual claim.

Still open: the orchestrator split into questions/evals/full with per-run-folder identity, the generation contract (answer prompt / abstention string / empty-context behavior), the top-k budget, which set to run (gold-100 vs full), and judge-calibration subset size.
